attempts.summary: Deployed an Ansible-driven internal DNS resolver on node1 (a minimal Python2 authoritative/forwarding UDP DNS server on port 53, opened via firewalld and run as a systemd service "mini-dns") that resolves inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.217.11) and forwards other queries upstream. Configured node2 via NetworkManager/nmcli, driven through Ansible raw tasks, to use node1 (10.100.217.10) as its DNS resolver. Verified resolution end-to-end from node2, then executed the mandatory one-node-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, and node3 (control node), proving boot-id changes and full recovery of the DNS service, firewall rules, persisted resolver config, and control-node Ansible connectivity after each restart.
